Deep Learning Program Overview

The Deep Learning Specialization explores the core of neural networks, including MLPs, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, and attention mechanisms. You'll gain a deep understanding of training techniques, optimization strategies, regularization, and transfer learning, with projects in computer vision and natural language domains.

Ideal for professionals targeting DL and AI research roles, this course offers extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and real-world datasets.
